mapping_type: priority-based multi-label to single chatbot intent mapping

intent_rules.description: Search, rescue, missing people, trapped people, and urgent rescue support.
Medical help, medicine, hospital access, injury, death, and health-related needs.
Requests or reports about clean water, drinking water, and sanitation needs.
Food shortage, food aid, and basic nutrition support messages.
Shelter, temporary housing, displacement, evacuation, and refugee support.
Transport disruption, road access, blocked roads, vehicles, and route safety.
Damage to buildings, drainage, bridges, electricity, and infrastructure systems.
Security, military, aid centers, shops, tools, and public service coordination.
Flood-specific messages, flood impact, river overflow, and water inundation reports.
Storm, hurricane, cyclone, and severe weather event messages.
General weather hazard, earthquake, cold, fire, or other weather-related alerts.
General help requests, aid-related reports, and direct disaster reports.
